title: Santa María–Calatrava Treaty
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Santa María–Calatrava Treaty", at revision 1380773151, opens: "The Santa María–Calatrava Treaty, originally named in Spanish as the Tratado definitivo de paz y amistad entre la República Mexicana y S.M.C. la Reina Gobernadora de España, was an international treaty concluded between Mexico and Spain on December 28, 1836." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q20160810, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "International treaty of 1836 that recognizes Mexico as a sovereign nation". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
